hypothesis: With the V3 recipe (60d/19800 CSZ, seed budget 19,800 steps) fixed, a same-timestamp grouped sampler and an MSE+pairwise-hinge objective may improve cross-sectional ranking; the pure-MSE arm with the same sampler isolates the ranking term, and alpha is fixed before training (1.0 pre-registered, 0.1 as the low-grid follow-up after the 1.0 arm collapsed).
decision: Keep V3 (60d/19800 CSZ three-seed shuffle ensemble). Grouped sampling alone loses 0.0018 ensemble RankIC with a 5-day interval below zero and adds 0.066 turnover versus shuffle. The pre-registered alpha=1.0 pairwise-hinge arm collapses (validation scores constant, ensemble RankIC 0.0416). The alpha=0.1 follow-up avoids collapse but at seed 11 does not beat the same-sampler MSE control (delta -0.0011, interval contains zero) and is 0.0058 below the V3 seed-11 model. The alpha=0.1 seed29/47 runs started at 2026-10-26T01:09:33Z but the cloud container became unreachable at 02:25 UTC, so their artifacts were not retrieved and the arm stays a single-seed exploration. No arm is promoted.
